label: Double effect, intention reading: condition 3 read as MEANS_2
term: doctrine of double effect (intention reading of condition 3)
definition: IntentionDoubleEffect c: as the causal reading, but condition 3 forbids only a harm that is a planned means (MEANS_2). Since MEANS_2 includes the plan, condition 3 is then implied by condition 2.
